_comment: PREP-A-03 digital twin of the contract vehicle (docs/ROV平台参数.md ROV-01..05, SON-01..03;
docs/ROV平台到货前准备工作规格-2026-09-02.md PREP-A-03). Not used directly: load
blue_rov_contract_mono.json (stage 1, MainCamera only) or blue_rov_contract_stereo.json
(stage 2, MainCamera + LeftCamera/RightCamera). Every uw_* key and this _comment are
repo-only and stripped by scenario_manifest.holoocean_scenario_cfg().
Profiles (SIM-PERF-002/003, tick_budget_2026-09-02.md): 'fidelity' = ticks 200,
frames_per_sec false, IMU 200 Hz, cameras 1920x1080 @ 25 Hz (30 fps is not an integer
tick divisor), sonar 40 Hz 768x512, RTF ~0.1; 'realtime' = ticks 25, frames_per_sec true,
cameras 960x540 @ 12.5 Hz, sonar 5 Hz 768x256, IMU/orientation/depth 25 Hz, RTF ~1.
Sonar modes: the contract sonar runs at 750 kHz (120 m, 0.95 deg beam) or 1.2 MHz
(50 m, 0.6 deg beam). HoloOcean's ImagingSonar has NO beam-width parameter, so the
angular-resolution difference between the two modes CANNOT be simulated; only the
range and a coarser noise floor (larger AddSigma/RangeSigma at 750 kHz) are modelled.
AzimuthBins stays 768 in both modes: the contract's 768 is the output beam count, not
a beam width (recorded as SIM-SON-004). Range resolution: the contract 2.5 mm over 50 m
would need 20000 bins; HoloOcean is capped by GPU cost, so 768x512 (~10 cm @ 50 m) is used.
IMU noise: HWT9053-485 nominal (vendor datasheet class values, NOT measured -- PREP-D-05
Allan run after delivery replaces them). HoloOcean AccelSigma/AngVelSigma are per-sample
sigmas = noise density * sqrt(rate): gyro 0.005 deg/s/sqrt(Hz) = 8.7e-5 rad/s/sqrt(Hz)
-> 1.23e-3 rad/s at 200 Hz; accel 100 ug/sqrt(Hz) = 9.8e-4 m/s^2/sqrt(Hz) -> 1.39e-2 m/s^2.
AccelBiasSigma/AngVelBiasSigma are per-sample random-walk steps (bias walk density *
sqrt(dt)): gyro 1e-5 rad/s/sqrt(s) -> 7.1e-7 rad/s; accel 1e-4 m/s^2/sqrt(s) -> 7.1e-6.
The same numbers appear as continuous densities in configs/rig/bluerov2_contract.yaml.
Heading: VehicleOrientation stays in the file (the realtime session needs it to build
VehicleState) but is NOT an algorithm topic; the session adds heading noise per
uw_metadata.heading_noise_model (ROV-03: heading +-1 deg, degraded by thruster current).
Sensor locations are CAD-pending initial values (metres, HoloOcean agent frame x fwd /
y right / z up): gimbal camera at the front of the electronics tube, sonar on the top
front bracket, IMU inside the tube. Stereo placeholders follow PREP-B-08 (10 cm pure-y
baseline, rigid, no gimbal). Gimbal pitch is locked at 0 deg (open question 3).
